{{Quote|Ambush! They're behind us!|The clone, while trying to get on his AT-RT|<ref name="Darkness on Umbara" />}}
A '''clone''' was part of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] as an [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force Trooper]] and participated at the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==Biography==
After the initial assault on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]], the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] managed to push back the [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] militia and claim a ridge to the north. As they rested on the entrenched ridge, Umbaran insurgents regrouped themselves for an ambush on the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] encampment. The clones were caught off guard and many of them were killed, including this trooper, who was shot in the back while trying to start his [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transport]].<ref name="Darkness on Umbara" />
